My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
Nuk • AI Assistant
Your item arrived damaged. According to our warranty information, you should report the damage promptly so the item can be evaluated. Once a claim is processed, we will provide further instructions. If the item is found to be defective, it may be repaired or replaced at no charge.
Please follow these steps:
1. Keep the damaged item and all packaging.
2. Take clear photos of:
   - the damage to the item
   - the outer box
   - the inner packaging
3. Prepare your order details and a brief description of the damage.
If you are signed in, I can guide you to the order lookup capability in your next message so you can access your order details. If you prefer, I can connect you with a human representative. Please let me know if you require further clarification.
